whatToWatch.text: Seattle's defense is the headline: 17.9 points allowed per game through seven is legit, and the Bears are coming into Lumen against a unit that's been the backbone of this 4-3 start.

Pass rush vs. pass rush — Seattle's getting 2.4 sacks a game, Chicago's getting 2.7. Whichever front wins the trench battle probably wins a game Vegas thinks is a coin flip with a field goal attached (SEA -3).

Injury watch matters here: three Seahawks are out with Charles Cross, Velus Jones Jr. and Drew Lock on the report, plus two questionable, while Chicago's down three of their own including Malik Muhammad II and D'Marco Jackson. Depth gets tested on both sides.

newsBlurb.text: Lumen Field hosts the Bears on Monday night, and the Week 8 spotlight belongs entirely to Seattle. Chicago walks into the loudest building in the league with no Sunday crowd noise to hide behind — a standalone national window, one game, full volume.
